validation.notes: 8 uncaught node:assert/strict scenarios run against the real submitted modules linked by .prale-eval/subject.mjs (createSessionPipeline: real migrations.ts + real utils/text.ts + real session-manager.ts; only getAgentDir and directory listing injected), with fixtures written under .prale-eval/.tmp-auth-migration and removed before exit. Passes with the repair (exit 0). Covered: (1) stripBom removes exactly one leading U+FEFF while plain text, interior BOMs and a second leading BOM survive, and splitBom stays lossless (bom+text===input); (2) BOM-encoded oauth.json plus BOM-encoded settings.json apiKeys merge into auth.json with OAuth kept for the overlapping provider, the distinct api key migrated, unrelated settings and an interior-BOM value retained, and oauth.json archived byte-for-byte as oauth.json.migrated; (3) the same contract for BOM-free inputs; (4) a pre-existing auth.json makes migration a complete no-op (auth.json, oauth.json and settings.json stay byte-identical, no .migrated archive, empty provider list); (5) malformed oauth.json is left untouched and not archived while API keys still migrate; (6) malformed settings.json keeps its bytes while OAuth migrates and archives; (7) settings without apiKeys create no auth.json and rewrite nothing; (8) a second run after a successful merge is a byte-identical no-op. Mutation checks: restoring packages/coding-agent/src/utils/text.ts alone to its faulty baseline (stripBom returning content) produces AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION] in scenario 1 (exit 1); restoring packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts alone to its faulty baseline (unconditional migrated[provider] = {type:'api_key'}) produces AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION] on the merged/reported providers in scenario 2 (exit 1). Neither mutation crashed, threw an import error or timed out, so both are genuine detected regressions, and the repaired tree then passes all scenarios. No package dependencies are installed in this workspace (none are required), so the repository's vitest suites plus tsgo/biome checks were not run; Node 24 stripTypeScriptTypes type-strips both repaired files during the run.

production_changes.change: stripBom now removes exactly one leading UTF-8 BOM via the existing splitBom helper instead of returning its input unchanged, so BOM-prefixed JSON decodes while plain and interior-BOM text is preserved.

migrateAuthToAuthJson skips settings.json apiKeys for providers already merged from oauth.json, so OAuth wins over same-provider API keys; the existing auth.json short-circuit, conditional OAuth archiving, selective apiKeys deletion and malformed-input no-touch behavior are retained.
